answer: Quality deposits: before an answer is graded, its author locks a small deposit. Graders score it on the published scale; if the median is 0, the deposit is burned, otherwise it is refunded after settlement. Validators check the lock and the settlement on-chain, so nothing rests on a whisper of trust. A farm posting templates from many identities loses one deposit per fake, so splitting multiplies its cost instead of hiding it. Limit: over a long horizon an honest newcomer may lose deposits to a harsh jury, so the deposit stays far below the zenith rewards reach.
